notes: Geometry-only mesh fit check. Mesh-versus-CAD centroid/volume deviations include tessellation and are not tolerances or physical qualification.
Axes use integrated tetrahedral volume covariance of the GLB triangles, avoiding nonuniform vertex-sampling bias; small deviations are tessellation/numeric effects.
Transforms use already-baked world coordinates: arms P + Rx(x-P); steer delta + K + Rz(x-K); tie Icurrent + Ralign(x-Inominal); rack x+[0,r,0].
Middle C02 fixed-steer corners are excluded from this C03 assembly.
